newsitem.title: BELGIUM: France urges EU to appeal WTO meat hormone ruling.
newsitem.headline: France urges EU to appeal WTO meat hormone ruling.

text.p: French Farm Minister Philippe Vasseur on Tuesday urged the European Union to contest a World Trade Organisation interim ruling against an EU ban on imports of hormone-treated beef from the United States.
"These (WTO) conclusions...are totally unacceptable," Vasseur told a meeting of EU farm ministers, adding that they put trade interests above those of public health.
The EU's 1988 ban on imports of hormone-treated meat was in response to the legitimate demands of consumers who reject artificial production methods, he said.
"I ask the Commission...to prepare its case for an appeal because I am certain the Community will appeal," he said.
Germany, Austria, Belgium and Italy supported the French demand, officials said.
EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler said that he was still studying the WTO disputes panel's confidential report.
"One thing at a time," a spokesman quoted Fischler as saying.
The spokesman added that the next step would probably be a request for an interim review of the ruling on June 4.
